settings.heading: STOCK CONTRARIO
settings.subtext: Exclusive B2B partnership for boutiques, concept stores, and global fashion retailers. Distinctive brutalist silhouettes, limited capsule runs.

settings.title: WASHINGTON, DC ROOTS
settings.description: Designed with the spirit and stark political brutalism of the capital.

settings.title: ARCHITECTURAL QUALITY
settings.description: Heavyweight premium cottons, raw finishes, and structured tailoring.

settings.title: LIMITED CAPSULES
settings.description: Never mass-produced. Controlled production runs preserve boutique exclusivity.

settings.title: TERRITORY PROTECTION
settings.description: Carefully managed distribution to ensure boutique margin integrity.

settings.heading: INDEPENDENT FASHION BORN IN WASHINGTON, DC.
settings.description: Contrario was created to subvert the ordinary. Driven by underground culture, architectural brutalism, and uncompromising craftsmanship, every silhouette represents an exploration of tension, texture, and defiance. We build limited collection runs for discerning multi-brand retailers.

settings.heading: KEY STYLES & CAPSULES
settings.description: A preview of our hero pieces. Full wholesale linesheet with tiered pricing and SKU matrix provided upon buyer qualification.
settings.cta_box_desc: We protect boutique margins. Request the private linesheet for B2B pricing and minimum order quantities.

settings.title: OPENING ORDER
settings.description: Initial opening commitment. No rigid per-SKU minimums; flexibility to mix caps, hoodies, tees, and accessories.

settings.title: PACK RATIO FREEDOM
settings.description: Choose exact sizing and product splits that match your specific customer demographics. No locked pre-packs required.

settings.title: ESTIMATED LEAD TIME
settings.description: In-stock core essentials ship within 48–72 hours. Custom capsule production batches ship within 2 to 3 weeks.

settings.title: AGILE REORDERS
settings.description: Reduced reorder minimum threshold allows retail partners to test new silhouettes and replenish fast sellers rapidly.

settings.title: DIRECT DISPATCH
settings.description: Tracked courier fulfillment (DHL / FedEx / UPS) with export documentation handled seamlessly.

settings.title: LOCAL EXCLUSIVITY
settings.description: Geographic exclusivity options available for flagship boutique stockists meeting quarterly volume tiers.

settings.heading: THE WHOLESALE PROGRAM
settings.description: Clear minimums, agile reorders, and direct fulfillment from our Washington DC & CDMX logistics nodes.

settings.heading: APPLY FOR WHOLESALE ACCOUNT
settings.description: We review boutique applications within 24 to 48 business hours. Once verified, you will receive our wholesale linesheet, lookbook, and direct order access.
settings.perk_1_desc: Wholesale tiered pricing, SKU breakdowns, and fabric weight specifications.
settings.perk_2_desc: Guaranteed inventory reservation before public direct-to-consumer drops.
settings.perk_3_desc: Dedicated representative for rapid replenishment and custom merchandising.
settings.confidentiality_note: All retailer submissions are held confidential. Wholesale pricing is disclosed only to verified trade accounts.
settings.success_message: Our wholesale team has received your details. We will review your store credentials and send our linesheet & pricing packet within 24-48 hours.
